project.name: ZenJS
project.summary: Foundation reactive UI framework package powered by @sylphx/zen with runtime exports, JSX helpers, components, benchmarks, demo app, website, and release workflow.
goals: Provide a small reactive UI framework with documented package exports and examples.
Keep framework runtime, JSX helpers, built-in components, benchmarks, demo app, website, and release workflow coherent.
Preserve consumer-neutral framework behavior on top of public @sylphx/zen exports.
nonGoals: Own one product's UI design system, routing policy, application state model, component library, or performance claim.
Own @sylphx/zen internals beyond documented package consumption.
Publish enterprise doctrine, project manifest schema, org rulesets, rollout issue reconciliation, or shared CI policy.

owns.name: zenjs-package
owns.description: The zenjs package exports, JSX runtime, reactive UI helpers, built-in components, type declarations, and package behavior.

owns.name: zenjs-docs-demo
owns.description: Repository-local demo app, website, docs, setup notes, and examples that explain framework usage.

owns.name: zenjs-benchmark-and-release
owns.description: Benchmark files, performance evidence, build config, and central release workflow wiring for this package.

doesNotOwn: Product-specific UI design systems, routing policy, app state models, component libraries, or downstream performance narratives.
@sylphx/zen internals beyond documented package exports and dependency compatibility.
Enterprise doctrine, project manifest schema, rollout issue reconciliation, org rulesets, or shared workflow implementation.

allowedDependencies.surface: project manifest schema, standards, and rollout audit

forbiddenCouplings: Do not require consumers to import internal source paths instead of documented zenjs package exports.
Do not encode one product's UI design, routing, state model, or component policy as hidden framework behavior.
Do not publish benchmark or performance claims without reproducible repository-local evidence.
Do not publish enterprise process policy from this repository instead of SylphxAI/doctrine or SylphxAI/.github.

delivery.deployPath: No pull-request CI workflow is present; main pushes call .github/workflows/release.yml to delegate package release handling to the central reusable workflow.
delivery.productionProof: Framework changes require build, typecheck, tests, benchmark evidence for changed performance claims, demo or website smoke, and package readback after release.

gaps.description: Add pull-request CI for build, typecheck, tests, lint, benchmark smoke, demo, and website checks before relying on automated admission.
Document package registry readback, docs readback, and consumer smoke evidence required after package releases.
Turn benchmark claims and comparison methodology into a stable benchmark contract or generated report.
